d: A monstrous demonic creature with a lean, muscular build, featuring a head encased in a jagged, dark charcoal grey helmet with glowing red accents and sharp protrusions. The entity has long, clawed fingers and a massive, swirling crimson tail that blends into ethereal smoke. It wears heavy, segmented armor in shades of dark grey and black, highlighted by glowing red geometric patterns and crimson plating. BODY COLOR: Dark charcoal grey and crimson LEGS: Digitigrade with sharp, clawed toes
